companies.name: ナビタス・セミコンダクター

relations.text: Navitasは、GaNの米国内ファウンドリ・パートナーであるGlobalFoundriesとの協業を競争上の強みとする
relations.text_en: Navitas treats its collaboration with GlobalFoundries on GaN as a competitive advantage.

source.label: Navitas Semiconductor 10-K
source.quote: As a result, we consider our collaboration with United States based foundry partners, specifically GlobalFoundries for GaN and X-Fabs for SiC, to be a competitive advantage, as we believe that foreign semiconductor companies and companies that rely on foreign supply chains will be disadvantaged in these critical markets.

relations.text: 2025年11月に、先進GaNソリューションの開発・提供に向けGlobalFoundriesとの長期の戦略的パートナーシップを発表した
relations.text_en: In November 2025 Navitas announced a long-term strategic partnership with GlobalFoundries to develop and deliver advanced GaN solutions

source.label: Navitas Semiconductor 10-K
source.quote: with Powerchip Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation and in November 2025, we announced a long-term strategic partnership with GlobalFoundries to develop and deliver advanced GaN solutions for critical applications in high power markets, including AI datacenters, energy and grid infrastructure, performance computing and industrial electrification.

relations.text: Cirrus Logicは、2026暦年末まで生産能力を確保しウエハー価格を定める能力予約・ウエハー供給コミットメント契約をGlobalFoundriesと結んでいる
relations.text_en: Cirrus Logic has a Capacity Reservation and Wafer Supply Commitment Agreement with GlobalFoundries that reserves capacity and sets wafer pricing through calendar year 2026

source.label: Cirrus Logic 10-K
source.quote: In fiscal year 2022, the Company entered into a Capacity Reservation and Wafer Supply Commitment Agreement with GlobalFoundries to reserve capacity and set wafer pricing for products purchased pursuant to the agreement through calendar year 2026.

relations.text: 同契約は2021年7月28日に結ばれた
relations.text_en: The agreement was entered into on July 28, 2021

source.label: Cirrus Logic 10-K
source.quote: In 2021, in an effort to alleviate some of our future expected supply constraints, the Company entered into a Capacity Reservation and Wafer Supply Commitment Agreement with GlobalFoundries on July 28, 2021 to reserve capacity and set wafer pricing for products purchased pursuant to the agreement through 2026.

relations.text_en: GlobalFoundries is combining its 200mm GaN-on-Si platform and U.S.-based manufacturing with onsemi's system and product expertise.

relations.text: GlobalFoundriesは、2026年1月13日にSynopsys, Inc.と最終契約を結んだ

relations.text: GlobalFoundriesは2009年に、Mubadala傘下の子会社がAMDのドレスデンの製造事業とニューヨーク州マルタの工場予定地を取得して設立された
relations.text_en: GlobalFoundries was established in 2009 when a Mubadala subsidiary acquired AMD's manufacturing operations in Dresden and its fab project site in Malta, New York

source.quote: GF was established in 2009 when a wholly-owned subsidiary of Mubadala, acquired Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.’s (“AMD”) manufacturing operations in Dresden, Germany, as well as their fab project site in Malta, New York.
